conflicts: ground-state hyperfine constants: King & Jaccarino 1954 (uncorrected) 79Br A = 884.810(3), B = -384.878(8) MHz; 81Br A = 953.770(3), B = -321.516(8) MHz versus Brown & King 1966 with second-order correction (Chichinin Table 2) 884.809774(62), -384.882835(200); 953.768180(62), -321.524277(200). The B values differ by more than the 1954 error bar because of the second-order correction.
2P1/2 lifetime: measured 0.96(9) s (He et al. 1999) versus 1.11 s from the NIST A = 0.90 s^-1 and 0.90 s calculated; all compatible within the experimental error except NIST's rounded A (1.6 sigma).
not_found: radiative lifetime of the TALIF upper level 5p 2[1]°3/2 (79178.33 cm^-1): Sirse et al., PSST 23, 062003 (2014) state in the abstract that the natural lifetime and the HBr quenching rate were determined, but the HAL abstract is truncated before the numbers and iopscience.iop.org answered with a bot-manager challenge. Not recorded.

radiative lifetime of 5p 4D°3/2 (76743.08 cm^-1, the 260.6 nm / 844.9 nm scheme) and of all other 5s, 5p, 6p levels in levels.csv: no measurement located in an openable source (Lawrence 1967 states that Br lifetimes could not be measured and gives calculated A values only).
